audio.strategy: Single AudioContext architecture unifying Organ (Layers A/B sharing one Organ FX chain + dedicated Rotary routing), Piano (Layers A/B with Timbre EQ, model voicing, and independent/grouped FX chains), and Synth (Layers A/B/C with independent/grouped FX chains and deterministic Arpeggiator/Gate). Every layer traverses the exact ordered Layer Effects chain (Mod 1 -> Mod 2 -> Delay -> Amp Sim/EQ -> Compressor -> Reverb) -> [Direct | Shared Rotary Speaker with morphable speed] -> Layer level -> Master Bus -> Master Level Gain -> Soft-Knee Limiter -> Brickwall Safety Clipper -> single Destination. Grand (78 stereo OGG), Upright (52 stereo OGG), Rhodes Mk I (15 mono OGG), and Wurlitzer EP200 (25 mono OGG) are bundled recorded cuts from inputs/samples/ (170 files total). Organ engines (B3/B3 Bass, Vox, Farf, Pipe 1/Pipe 2), Synth engine (Pure/Sync/Multi/Super/FM-H), Clav/Digital/Misc piano types, sympathetic string resonance, reverb impulse responses, and the labeled sample-failure fallback are live/generated Web Audio synthesis.

generatedSources.name: Clavinet D6 & Harpsichord 8' Live Synthesis
generatedSources.description: Live Web Audio sawtooth/square harmonic plucked synthesis with resonant pickup highpass/peaking EQ and decaying lowpass envelope; Soft Release disabled per manual p. 25.

generatedSources.name: DX E.Piano & FM Bell Grand Live Synthesis
generatedSources.description: Live Web Audio 2-operator FM synthesis (carrier + frequency-modulated sine modulator with velocity-scaled modulation index and fast bell decay + warm body harmonic).

generatedSources.name: Concert Marimba & Warm Vibraphone Live Synthesis
generatedSources.description: Live Web Audio bar synthesis combining fundamental sine, 4th/3.98x harmonic overtone decay, and 5.5 Hz motor fan amplitude modulation on Vibraphone.

generatedSources.name: Simulated Sympathetic String Resonance
generatedSources.description: Live Web Audio sympathetic overtone resonance activated when String Res is enabled and sustain pedal or companion notes are held.

generatedSources.name: Procedural Stereo Reverb Impulse Responses (Booth/Room/Spring/Stage/Hall/Cathedral)
generatedSources.description: Deterministic seeded PRNG exponentially decaying filtered stereo AudioBuffers (plus dispersive metallic chirp for Spring) generated in memory per AudioContext in src/audio/effectUnits.ts.

generatedSources.name: Harmonic Piano Synthesis Fallback
generatedSources.description: Live Web Audio additive/filtered triangle+sine harmonic voice used only while recorded samples are loading or if sample fetching/decoding fails. Truthfully labeled as fallback in UI status and Program OLED.

generatedSources.name: Organ Engines (B3, B3 Bass, Vox Continental, Farfisa Compact, Pipe 1, Pipe 2)
generatedSources.description: Live Web Audio multi-partial PeriodicWave & formant-EQ synthesis in src/audio/organVoice.ts: 9-drawbar tonewheel B3 with foldback, single-triggered 2nd/3rd percussion, and filtered-noise key click; B3 Bass (16'/8'); Vox Continental (7 transistor partials + flute/reed mix drawbars); Farfisa Compact (9 on/off register switches >=5/8 with nasal formant EQ); Pipe 1 & Pipe 2 (9 pipe ranks 16'-1' with wind-chiff onset and rank detuning); plus per-layer Vibrato/Chorus (V1-V3, C1-C3).

generatedSources.name: 3-Layer Analog & FM-H Synth Engine with Deterministic Arpeggiator/Gate
generatedSources.description: Live Web Audio synthesis in src/audio/synthVoice.ts and src/audio/arpeggiator.ts supporting Pure (Sine, Triangle, Saw, Square, Pulse 33, Pulse 10, White Noise), Sync (Sync Saw, Sync Square), Multi (Multi Saw, Multi Saw 8ve), Super (Super Saw, Super Square), and FM-H (FM 2-op Algorithm A) with category-correct Osc Ctrl, LP12/LP24/LP M/HP/BP/LP+HP filters with tracking/resonance/drive, Osc/Filter/Amp envelopes, 5-waveform Master-Clock-syncable LFO (incl. Sample & Hold), Poly/Mono/Legato/Priority/Glide/Unison/Vibrato, and deterministic Arpeggiator/Gate.

notes: All 170 bundled audio files under public/samples/ (78 Grand, 52 Upright, 15 Rhodes Mk I, 25 Wurlitzer EP200) are verbatim onset-trimmed, faded, and Ogg Vorbis q4 re-encoded cuts from inputs/samples/ with no pitch-shifting, time-stretching, or layering baked into the files.
Fine tuning offsets from upstream SFZ/Data metadata are applied at runtime via AudioBufferSourceNode.playbackRate for accurate A440 equal temperament.
Rhodes Mk I is recorded at a single dynamic per note in the pack; velocity dynamics are shaped at runtime via gain and dynamic lowpass filtering.

Phase 3 connects Organ (2 layers, 6 models, 9 drawbars, percussion, key click, V/C, shared FX chain & Rotary), Piano (2 layers, 6 types), Synth (3 layers, 14 required waveforms across Pure/Sync/Multi/Super/FM-H, filters, 3 envelopes, LFO, voice modes, deterministic Arp/Gate), Layer Effects (6 chains + Rotary + Group/Global/Bypass), and Programs (32 slots, 12 factory programs, 8 auto-storing Live slots, Store/Store As, List View, Undo, Splits/Zones/Crossfades, Scenes I/II, Wheel & Control Pedal morphs, Master Clock, Transpose ±6, Panic) on one shared AudioContext.
